messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hey{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
It's {04 1f 00}!

I bet you're pretty curious
about what sort of people I
hang out with, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Well, I just got this letter{01 00 00 05 00}
from this friend of mine
that's kinda{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}weird.
{07 14 00}I'll show it to you if you

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hey, hey{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! {07 0b 00}You're not
doing anything big, right?
Of course not! {01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00}That's why

{06 00 00 08 09}
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hei, hei{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! {07 0b 00}Sa ei tee ju
midagi tähtsat, eks?
Muidugi mitte! {01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00}Seepärast

{06 00 00 08 09}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So?! Whaddaya think,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 01 00 05 05 05}

Creeeepy!

{07 00 00}Nii?! Mida sa arvad,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 01 00 05 05 05}

messages.en:
{07 04 00}I know, right?!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 03 00}Har har har!
I thought so, too!{01 00 00 14 00}

{07 16 00}I mean, it's no big deal
{07 14 00}as long as we both agree on

messages.et:
{07 04 00}Eks ole?!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 03 00}Har har har!
Ma arvasin ka nii!{01 00 00 14 00}

{07 16 00}Ma mõtlen, pole suurt asja
{07 14 00}seni, kuni oleme ühel

messages.en:
{07 00 00}How was it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 06 00}It makes you kinda feel

{07 00 00}But, you know{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 13 00}I think

{07 00 00}Kuidas oli, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 06 00}See tekitab pisut

{07 00 00}Aga tead{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 13 00}Ma arvan,

messages.en:
{07 16 00}It sounds stupid, but {01 00 00 05 00}I
can't even remember {01 00 00 05 00}where
or when I got that letter.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}All I can say is I obviously
got it from someone I
didn't care about!
{07 06 00}Unless I got it from you.
Then I, uh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0c 00} You didn't
send it to me, did you?!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kõlab rumalalt, aga {01 00 00 05 00}ma
ei mäleta isegi, {01 00 00 05 00}kust
või millal ma selle sain.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Võin öelda vaid, et sain
selle ilmselt kelleltki,
kellest ma ei hoolinud!
{07 06 00}Kui just mitte sinult.
Siis ma, ee{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0c 00} Sa ei
